qualifier: The 18-case benchmark uses hand-written cases with constructed outputs, so it tests that the metric suite separates good answers from bad ones. It is not an evaluation of any language model, and token-overlap faithfulness is a heuristic.

bridge: The most worked-through evaluation in my portfolio is in the Copilot: a frozen, hash-locked held-out retrieval set, mutation checks on every defence, an adversarial draft corpus whose failures are kept, and one real-model run reported with its four failure classes and its protocol deviation, not summarised into a score.
